subject: Follow-up: stakeholder interlock and buying process — next steps
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Joe Park <joe.park@healthtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-04T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: stakeholder interlock and buying process — next steps

Hi Joe —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a few asks to help us put together the right procurement/technical package for HealthTech.

TL;DR: Redwood can meet the latency and data-residency constraints you described; to prepare a focused proposal we need a short list of approvers and the procurement/legal contacts + your timeline and decision criteria.

Notes from the call (very condensed):
- Primary use-case: internal clinical search and chart summarization (P0).
- Key constraints: sub-200ms median token latency for 2k-context calls; on-prem/VAULT KMS integration for PHI; 12–18 month retention policy request.
- Initial pilot: 3 services, ~5M tokens/month; expand across 8 teams if pilot meets KPIs.

Action items for your team (requested):
1) Economic buyer / exec sponsor (name & email).
2) Procurement contact (email) + any standard procurement doc templates.
3) Legal/security contact for SOC2 / data residency questions.
4) Org chart or list of approvers (who signs SOW + who signs budget).
5) Desired decision date or contract target (we heard "end of Q2" but want confirmation).

What we will deliver next:
- ROI summary & unit-cost projection for the pilot (Ben + Marissa will prepare).
- Short compliance brief addressing KMS, retention, and audit logging for Liam/legal.
- Draft SOW skeleton and procurement checklist.

If possible, please send items 1–4 as an org chart or one-pager. Attaching my quick post-call notes for reference (postcall-notes-ava.pdf).

Proposed next step: 30-minute interlock with procurement/legal + FM sponsor — are you able to introduce procurement? We can flex to their calendar.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

—
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Joe Park <joe.park@healthtech.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: stakeholder interlock and buying process — next steps

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our internal notes. I'm attaching a high-level approver chart (HealthTech_approver_chart.pdf) that shows who needs to sign commercially vs who reviews technically. Quick answers inline: 

- Economic buyer / sponsor: Maya Rao (VP Product) — maya.rao@healthtech.com. She owns product budget and will sign the SOW.
- Procurement: procurement@healthtech.com (this routes to our shared procurement mailbox; primary lead is Priya Sharma on a weekly rotation).
- Legal/Security review: Liam O'Connor (liam.oconnor@healthtech.com) — he asks for a short compliance brief and SOC2 evidence.
- Timeline: internal target is a vendor decision by 2028-06-30 (end of Q2). Pilot procurement paperwork needs to be complete ~2 weeks prior to kickoff.
- Decision criteria (priority order): 1) Security/compliance posture (KMS + auditability), 2) Unit economics at scale, 3) Predictable latency under load, 4) Integration complexity.

Two clarifying items for your team: can you confirm expected on-prem footprint (vGPU counts) for the pilot and whether Redwood has a standard data-retention addendum we can share with legal?

I've copied Maya and Liam on this thread for awareness. Attaching approver chart now.

Attachments: HealthTech_approver_chart.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Joe
Director of Platform Partnerships | HealthTech
joe.park@healthtech.com | +1 212-555-4477

Great context from Joe — thanks. Plan from our side:

1) Marissa: Can you spin up a concise ROI / TCO memo tailored to their pilot (5M tokens/month) that shows per-token cost across hosted vs dedicated vs private options? Use ROI-template.xlsx as the starter (attached). Key fields: estimated monthly costs, projection at +3x scale, non-recurring (migration/integration) estimates.

2) Marissa + Sean: Draft a short compliance summary (1–2 pages) that addresses: KMS/HSM options, retention addendum language, SOC2 artifacts we can provide, and how audit logs are surfaced in the Console. Put the legal-facing points first for Liam.

3) I will prepare the SOW skeleton and procurement checklist (initial-sow-stub.docx) with placeholders for procurement routing and signature blocks.

4) Ava: once Marissa and Sean have drafts, let's package everything and schedule a 30-min procurement interlock with procurement@healthtech.com, Liam, and Maya (if Maya can make it). Ben will arrive with a high-level cost slide and risk mitigation notes.

Deadline ask: Can we get the ROI and compliance summary by end of day Tuesday 2028-03-07? That gives us time to iterate before a Thu/Friday interlock.

Attachments: ROI-template.xlsx

Thanks —

Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
